summary: Surreal Software and Midway's morality-driven horror shooter series starring Torque.

entries.title: The Suffering

emulation.notes: Use Windows/GOG for play; PCSX2/xemu only for original-console comparison.

primary.why: The Suffering released for PlayStation 2, Xbox, and Windows, and later returned on GOG.com. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most accessible modern route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows/GOG release natively; use PS2 or Xbox only for original-console comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: PC release with later GOG availability.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most accessible modern route.
skip: lower practical fidelity than Windows and no sourced content advantage.
skip: original console route but no sourced content advantage over Windows.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive content requires a secondary route; Windows is the modern fidelity/access pick.

entries.remaster_caveats: The modern route is a PC re-release, not a full remaster.
